intelligence.human_view: Think of it this way: a button is a promise. Smart Meet promised a meeting and opened a timeline instead — a row of times with diamonds on them, nothing you could actually book. He said fix the promise: Smart Meet opens book-a-time, and the timeline becomes real slots you can book into. The smart bars are the same idea at a bigger scale — instead of one giant feed of everything, the system sorts every note and post into its right category all by itself, and you just tap a tab to see that category. The news works the same honest way: one story, gathered from all its sources, with links to every one of them, delivered fresh every day for you, from where you're actually from. And when someone new asks the big questions — what is this, is it live, what do I need — we don't sell them a line. We tell them true: here's what works today, here's what's still being built, here's the date we haven't set, and all you need is a phone and ten answers about yourself.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a button that always opens the right thing! Smart Meet opens book-a-time, and the timeline is real slots you can book! The smart bars sort everything for you, all by themselves! Tap a tab and see just those notes — nothing else mixed in! One story, all its sources, told fresh every day just for you! And if someone new asks what this is, we tell them true! One mind, many minds, all learning together — and you at the center! A phone is enough, your name and ten answers, and you are in!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — a button should do what it says it does, dear, and ours didn't, so he fixed it! Smart Meet opens the booking now, love, and the timeline is real times you can actually book, not just pretty diamonds! The smart bars sort everything for you, dear, all by themselves — tap a little tab and see just those notes, nothing else mixed in! The news comes fresh every day, love, one story with all its sources linked, from where you are actually from! And if someone new asks what all this is, dear, we tell them true — what works today, what is still coming, and all you need is a phone and ten little answers about yourself!
intelligence.naya_view: Smart Meet opens book-a-time, never the timeline; the timeline is real bookable slots, a booked time shows there; Book a Time opens with the time thing at the top; alignment consistent on every slide. The summary of the day is labeled icons, clickable — daily intelligence, journal, reports — with nine smart notes for the day, clickable and enterable. One weather entry, on the wisdom slide only, bottom left; the clones come off every other slide; the day nav sits just above the bottom frame, clear of the content, on every slide. Smart tabs scroll slowly across the top; every note and post is auto-categorized on entry, shown in All and in its category; the tabs are the Collective, Personal and Activity buttons, just smaller — same rich glow, never neon. The news system pulls local, provincial and global every day, per person, from join data only; one post per story, all source links attached, smart notes per topic; optimization on the BACK, beauty on the front; feeds ON THE DAY, toggle off by default. AI Unity: humans and AIs as one mind, the person at the centre, the Nayas learning together. The launch question gets its honest three parts — what works, what is coming, no date invented. To start: a phone, the walk, name, certificate, ten questions; the one-profile-per-browser limit is a bug, not a rule. The functions list names everything once, booking and auto-organizing marked as coming.
